subject: Corpus compute on 742cdf3d: 2240 modules, 2062 compiled, 178 refused, 0 aborts; no regression vs 57db4be4
body: All compute.spv under workers/corpus_inputs/evidence-current-* (2240 modules at loop start) through compile_compute_v2 on 742cdf3d: 2062 compiled, 178 explicit refusals, 0 SIGABRT. Every refused module also refuses on 57db4be4 with the same rc (171 rc4, 7 rc5): no compiled->refused regression. Refusal classes: 91 'buffers require set0 single descriptors0..7' (buffer binding >7 or set!=0), 73 physical pointers/BDA, 7 'Mali backend emitted no code', 4 descriptor arrays, 3 private memory beyond the TLS immediate range. Table gpu/build/lowering-claude-20261025/final-742cdf3d/corpus-compute/{outcomes.tsv,refused-old-vs-new.tsv}. Next genuine compiler gaps by count: >8 buffer bindings (91) then BDA (73). Host-only.
